verdict.rationale: The only mobile evidence is an iOS lock-screen widget for one-tap audio memo capture. That shows an iOS app with some capture ability, but nothing shows full knowledge-base parity on mobile. Search, linking and backlinks are documented without any mention of mobile platforms. Missing for 10: any evidence of an Android app, search on mobile, linking/backlinks on mobile, documentation that the mobile apps match the desktop feature set, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile use.

support.subject: As a power-user, full-featured iOS and Android apps give me my whole knowledge base — capture, search, and linking — not a stripped-down companion

citations.quote: Our iOS has a lock screen widget that lets you start taking an audio memo with one tap.
